referenceSources.description:
A yellow Opel Astra V8 Coupe, campaigned by OPC Team Phoenix in the 2003 DTM series, is showcased indoors behind a protective railing. The car’s aggressive rear aero package features a large wing, diffuser, and side vents, all finished in the team’s bright yellow livery. Prominent sponsor decals include BOSCH on the rear window, Dunlop on the bumper, and H&R near the wheel arch.

Spectators gather around the display, examining the race-prepped details and the slogan “Opel. Frisches Denken für bessere Autos.” printed along the side. The image, captured at 1600×1200 resolution, is available under the GNU Free Documentation License on Wikimedia Commons, permitting sharing and adaptation with proper attribution.
